# game probe summary

Seeds: 0..32; samples every 120 ticks.

Quantiles use linear interpolation. Day checkpoints are exact even when the sampling interval does not divide a day. Idle breach share is cumulative sampled breaches / sampled agents (including tick 0). Performance uses primary-engine tick wall time minus measured read-only census observer time / exact pre-tick agent count sum; run wall time includes census, I/O and optional twin validation. Agent-days integrate every pre-tick living count; social rate counts completed interaction pairs per agent-day. Idle actionable uses the decision actionable_need helper and rule-aware NeedAvailability (hunger, thirst and fatigue). Idle unavailable independently means a survival need is breached but none of its matching resource tiles has positive supply. Legacy rules force helper availability true, so these two counts can overlap under legacy rules. Old idle_with_breach remains hunger/thirst only.

## Death census

Every tick is observed, independently of raw sample frequency. Death rows use completed-tick numbering (first engine tick = 1). Needs/state are captured after decay, immediately before the lethal phase; partner liveness is measured at that phase boundary. A partner killed in the same lethal batch may therefore still be marked alive. Initially breached agents start their history at their first observation. No-breach history and missing water/home distances are null. Dominant-state ties use lexical order; state ticks include the breach observation. Inferred causes are checked against cumulative tallies every tick; a mismatch aborts the probe.

## Food economy

Supply counts each renewable source once across the union of settlement forage catchments. Production birth gates still use each settlement's own catchment, so overlapping v8 settlements may each plan against that same source. Worlds without sustain use reporting utilization 0.85 and radius 16. Need sums actual live-agent hunger rates in AgentId order. Harvested/day is the difference between successive elapsed-day counters.

## Rhythm

Ratios are calculated at display-clock snapshots on days 2..N, then median per seed and across seeds. Empty denominators yield zero; observation counts distinguish missing clock samples. Clock/day extra rows never change periodic T6 sampling. Coincident sample kinds emit separate raw rows. Child observations run every tick; deaths are separated from observed maturation and living children may not remain marked Child beyond due tick +61.
